name: Field Goals Made
description: The total number of field goals successfully made by the player or team.

name: Field Goals Attempted
description: The total number of field goal shots attempted by the player or team.

name: Three-Pointers Made
description: The total number of three-point shots successfully made.

name: Three-Pointers Attempted
description: The total number of three-point shot attempts.

name: Free Throws Made
description: The total number of successful free throw shots.

name: Free Throws Attempted
description: The total number of free throw shots attempted.

name: Total Points
description: The total number of points scored by the player or team.

name: Blocks
description: The number of opponent shot attempts that were deflected or stopped by the player or team.

name: Steals
description: The number of times a player or team legally took the ball away from an opponent, resulting in a change of possession.

name: Assists
description: The number of passes that directly led to a made basket by a teammate.

name: Minutes Played
description: The total number of minutes the player was on the court.

name: Offensive Rebounds
description: The number of rebounds collected by the player or team on the offensive end after a missed shot.

name: Defensive Rebounds
description: The number of rebounds collected by the player or team on the defensive end after a missed shot.

name: Total Rebounds
description: The total number of rebounds collected by the player or team, including both offensive and defensive rebounds.

name: Personal Fouls
description: The number of fouls committed by a player that are not technical or flagrant.

name: Technical Fouls
description: The number of technical fouls called against the player or team due to unsportsmanlike conduct or other infractions.

name: Turnovers
description: The number of times a player or team lost possession of the ball to the opposing team.

name: Field Goal Percentage
description: The shooting percentage calculated from field goals made divided by field goals attempted.

name: Three-Point Percentage
description: The shooting percentage calculated from three-point shots made divided by three-point shots attempted.

name: Free Throw Percentage
description: The shooting percentage calculated from free throws made divided by free throws attempted.
